title: Skydive Castroville
specs: Jump from 12,000 feet with freefall of 35-45 seconds at speeds over 125 mph
Parachute opens at 5,000 feet with 5-7 minute peaceful descent
Scenic views of Texas Hill Country, San Antonio skyline, Medina River, and Castroville poppies
Must be 18 years or older with valid ID (Driver's License, ID card, Passport)
Maximum weight 235 lbs; over 200 lbs must be at least 5'8" tall, exceptions may apply
No alcohol, drugs, or being under influence to board aircraft
Must obey all airport rules and regulations
Two tandem pairs per aircraft flight

blurb: Guests experience tandem skydiving over Texas Hill Country and the San Antonio skyline, securely harnessed to certified instructors. The jump includes freefall from 12,000 feet, parachute deployment at 5,000 feet, and a 5-7 minute parachute ride. Experienced jumpers can purchase jump tickets and participate in special events like skydiving during solar eclipses.

quotes.author: Deantrae McInnis
quotes.text: It was amazing jump. It was my first time. I will recommend this place to everyone. Staff was super friendly and nice. I enjoy my time there excellent Service and staff!

quotes.author: Colandra
quotes.text: Colandra 12/22/2025 Adam was an excellent person to skydive with. From start to finish, he made me feel safe, comfortable, and confident. His professionalism, calm attitude, and clear communication helped ease any nerves and made the entire experience enjoyable. I couldn’t have asked for a better instructor and would highly recommend Adam and the whole Castroville crew to anyone considering skydiving.

quotes.author: Serendipity
quotes.text: Serendipity 12/27/2025 This was absolutely the best possible experience I could ever have hoped for. Definitely hooked. I'll be back and bring more people with me! Adding to say, shared my video with friends and now about to book a "girls" trip to jump with my bestie. True friends support and join you in jumping out of perfectly good Zip tied planes 😁
